name: Storage Sense
notes: Researched from the public Storage Sense Pay Bill page and FAQ (no sign-in, no one-time code requested). Pay Bill: choose a location, Email, Password (6-20 characters), Forgot your password?, Sign in with One-Time Code (code sent to email or phone), Register a new account; new website users must create an account before paying. Help line (877) 330-0227. FAQ: Pay Bill -> log in -> pick the unit; you can prepay upcoming months; month-to-month leases, move out any time without penalty even during a discount; 5% senior (65+) and 10% active-military discounts; $50 referral credit; lien sales held online after the state lien process. No AutoPay, fee, late-fee or move-out steps are published: autopay unknown with a contact note, cancel_service unsupported online (inferred). The one-time-code sign-in is not modelled (cross-owner request: passwordless code sign-in). Review 2026-10-10: the Pay Bill page also has Sign in with Google / Create with Google (socialProviders google) and Quick Pay - Checkout as Guest with location, Mobile Phone Number and Unit# (guest_pay supported; location is not modelled).

sources.title: Pay Your Bill at Storage Sense

passwordRule.message: Password must be between 6 and 20 characters

registration.note: New to the Storage Sense website? Create an account before using online payments.

autopay.note: For automatic payments, contact your Storage Sense office or call (877) 330-0227.

cancel_service.note: Leases are month-to-month and you can move out any time without a penalty. Tell your Storage Sense office, or call (877) 330-0227.

guest_pay.note: Quick Pay lets you check out as a guest: choose your location and enter your unit number and mobile phone number.

help.title: Paying your bill online
paragraphs: Select Pay Bill at the top of the site, sign in, and choose the unit you want to pay for. You can also pay ahead for upcoming months.

If you are new to the Storage Sense website, register a new account before you pay, or use Quick Pay to check out as a guest with your location, unit number and mobile phone number. You can also sign in with Google or with a one-time code sent to your email or phone. Trouble signing in? Call (877) 330-0227.
steps: Choose your location and sign in with your email.

help.title: Discounts
paragraphs: Customers 65 and older get a 5% senior discount on the monthly bill, and active-duty military members get 10% off. When you refer a friend, you both get $50 off your next rental.

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: All Storage Sense leases are month-to-month, so you can move out whenever you like, even in the middle of a discount period, without a penalty. Let your office know, or call (877) 330-0227.

extra.intent: Using the Storage Sense FAQ, find the senior discount on the monthly bill and who qualifies. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Customers 65 and older get 5% off the monthly bill.
